  Evidence: https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/blob/a9ddb312f9b00dd492ba73b5394a72c601ef2c94/doc/module-component.md#L6-L23 and https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/blob/a9ddb312f9b00dd492ba73b5394a72c601ef2c94/doc/module-component.md#L146-L173 and https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/blob/a9ddb312f9b00dd492ba73b5394a72c601ef2c94/doc/module-component.md#L242-L254

- **Text inputs + filtering**: the `input.cpp` example shows multiple `Input()` widgets, password mode, `CatchEvent()` filtering, a vertical container, a `Renderer(...)`, and `screen.Loop(...)`.  
  Evidence: https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/blob/a9ddb312f9b00dd492ba73b5394a72c601ef2c94/examples/component/input.cpp#L24-L67

- **Buttons / toggle / radio composition**: `gallery.cpp` shows `Menu`, `Toggle`, `Checkbox`, `Radiobox`, `Input`, `Button`, all wrapped with `Renderer(...)`, then assembled in `Container::Vertical(...)` and run with `screen.Loop(component)`.  
  Evidence: https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/blob/a9ddb312f9b00dd492ba73b5394a72c601ef2c94/examples/component/gallery.cpp#L17-L27 and https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/blob/a9ddb312f9b00dd492ba73b5394a72c601ef2c94/examples/component/gallery.cpp#L29-L151

- **Event loop / redraw pattern**: for apps that need periodic updates, `homescreen.cpp` uses `Loop`, checks `HasQuitted()`, calls `RequestAnimationFrame()`, then `RunOnce()`.  
  Evidence: https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI/blob/a9ddb312f9b00dd492ba73b5394a72c601ef2c94/examples/component/homescreen.cpp#L516-L529

- **File loading from a data dir**: a C++ sample in `glTF-SDK` resolves resources against an explicit base path (`path.parent_path()`), builds paths with `std::filesystem::u8path`, opens streams in binary mode, and validates the stream before use. Best practice takeaway: resolve a stable `data_root` once, don’t rely on cwd, and keep file I/O outside component lambdas.  
  Evidence: https://github.com/microsoft/glTF-SDK/blob/004a5cecf3768fa944240592ca8dd39f3b0ca862/GLTFSDK.Samples/Deserialize/Source/main.cpp#L37-L67 and https://github.com/microsoft/glTF-SDK/blob/004a5cecf3768fa944240592ca8dd39f3b0ca862/GLTFSDK.Samples/Deserialize/Source/main.cpp#L201-L206
